faq.q: How much does GW Law Group charge?
faq.a: GW Law Group publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee.

faq.q: Does GW Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: GW Law Group does not publish a free consultation on the pages we read. That is not the same as charging for one, and it is worth asking. It publishes material in Chinese.

faq.q: Where does GW Law Group have offices?
faq.a: GW Law Group publishes one office, in Flushing. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at GW Law Group?
faq.a: GW Law Group names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about GW Law Group?
faq.a: GW Law Group scores 40 and sits at Listed. Passed: footprint. Did not pass: entity registration and website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
